eps.t: THE SAVIOR WHO COULD NOT BRING SALVATION
eps.ov: Tetsuo Yabusame, an unlikely defender of Earth, heads into a furious battle against 20,000 kaiju.
In search of life in frozen ruins, Tetsuo encounters human survivors that he's been searching for.
Tetsuo joins Ao's group, then confronts new intergalactic kaiju alone until who should appear but...

eps.t: THE KAIJU TAMER AND THE CAN OF PINEAPPLE
eps.ov: Tetsuo is welcomed by the survivors at the Mishima Mall. But why is it so warm in a frozen world?
A new enemy seeks out the Mishima Mall as a targeted Testsuo visits Hagane's late mother's lab.
Driven by jealousy, a former member of E-RDE commands a merciless attack on Tetsuo and the others!
Overwhelmed by the powerful kaiju, Hercules, Tetsuo turns the tide of battle with... Communication!
The Boss activates a secret defense system against the kaiju, but can the Mall hold out for Tetsuo?
Ao returns to the Mall and takes on the enemy while the Boss recounts Sagami's past!
A rematch with Hercules begins. The Mishima Mall vs. VIERDE battle reaches its climax!

eps.t: I WANT TO BE A SAVIOR
eps.ov: After a fierce battling, Tetsuo defeats Hercules. In a daze, Sagami confesses a shocking truth… !
Sagami loses his will to fight. VIERDE's story unfolds their survival during the Big Freeze.
Turns out Nadare is the humanoid behind the Big Freeze. Tetsuo and Yukio fight the ultimate enemy.
